text: [[identity-app-origins-trusted-as-clients]]: a security review of the new sign-in provider found 1 high defect on bleeding: a connected app's page can call the identity service as the signed-in person, and may reach an admin token. The fix is queued and needs no answer from you. Nothing from this build goes to main before it lands. [[example-apps-notes-v2-plus-note_viewer]]: steps 1 to 3b are on bleeding; step 4, note_viewer and its e2e stack, is building. 0.5.2 waits for PR 13 (held).
